name: Scroll To
description: Always center the view on this object, or at the mid-point of multiple objects.

conditions.description: Test if the behavior is enabled.

actions.description: Shake the screen for a duration of time.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.desc: The strength of the shake, in maximum pixels to scroll away.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: The time the shake should last, in seconds.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Select whether the magnitude gradually reduces to zero over the duration, or stays constant.

state.name: State
state.desc: Whether to enable or disable the behavior.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.
